why / where it would go: The same object: an `n_star x n_star` matrix where this lane returns its diagonal. It is `k(X*, X*) - V^T V`, so it is one more kernel-matrix evaluation and one more GEMM at `OP_TN`; the work is small and the reason it is not here is that nothing in rung 1 consumes it. `sample_y` (DEVIATION 2793) builds the same matrix inside its own call and factors it; it does not return it

DEVIATION 1765. `2^(1-nu)/gamma(nu) * (sqrt(2 nu) d)^nu * kv(nu, sqrt(2 nu) d)`, where `kv` is a modified Bessel function of the second kind of REAL order. There is no `kv` in this repository, none in MAX, and no device implementation on any of the three vendors; implementing it means certifying a NEW transcendental under IDENTITY_PATHS row 12 before one cell of it could be trusted. `gp_kernel_matern` refuses it with that closure condition in the message

It is exactly the RBF, and sklearn implements it as such. Refused rather than aliased so that a caller who wants it says RBF and gets the kernel whose gates it actually ran (CONTRIBUTING.md (Non-default paths): a non-default path is an unchecked path)

`sigma_0^2 + x . y`. It is the one supported-family kernel with a COORDINATE-DEPENDENT diagonal, so implementing it turns `gp_kernel_diag` from a scalar into a vector and changes the `gp.kss` card stage from a scalar into an array (DEVIATION 1770 says so). It is also non-stationary, so it does not go through the distance path at all

`(1 + d^2/(2 alpha l^2))^-alpha`. One new transcendental seam, `identical_pow` at a data-dependent exponent, which `checks/numerics.mojo` already carries (row 12) -- so this is the cheapest of the unimplemented kernels and the obvious rung-2 first move

`exp(-2 (sin(pi d / p) / l)^2)`. Needs `identical_sin` (row 12, DEVIATION 820) at an argument that grows with the data, where the Cephes range reduction is exactly where a sin implementation diverges between vendors. A real implementation, not a hard one, but its numerics need their own gate

`Exponentiation` is `k^p` and needs `identical_pow` per cell; `PairwiseKernel` dispatches into `sklearn.metrics.pairwise`, a table of metrics this lane has no opinion about; `CompoundKernel` is the multi-output construction and is blocked behind DEVIATION 1763. All three are refused by name in `gp_kernel_from_name`
